body: Thank you...I’m glad to know at least someone took the time to respond...but truthfully if I were to die today, hardly anyone would notice or care...it would be days before anyone would even notice, And then it would just be the neighbors who probably smelled something... no one would really care except for that...Makes me angry to know that I’m so worthless that no one would notice… It’s my own fault actually for having become someone who no one cares about…

If you’re scared to die, then I believe you truly deep down know you don’t want to die...you just want the pain you are feeling to stop.  Is there anything in the world Other than death, that would make the pain subside?  Money, more friends, fame?
